title: Rust SF assignment tests do not consume the canonical JSON vector set
description: rust/lichen-core/src/sf_assignment.rs says its hard-coded assertions are from test/vectors/sf_assignment.json but covers only four hash cases and does not load gateway/fallback/distribution cases. Add an integration consumer that executes every categorized vector and fails on unknown/unhandled cases so Rust-Python-vector drift cannot hide.
close_reason: Added strict Rust integration consumer for every canonical sf_assignment.json vector, including hash, distribution, gateway precedence, and join fallback; unknown vector fields fail. Test passes and correctness/security/robustness reviews are dry.
